evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To this end, we propose PersonalQuery-Benchmark (PQB).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: PQB models personalized syntactic expression and personalized writing errors from users' historical texts, constructs personalized syntactic expression queries and personalized writing-error queries, and validates benchmark quality through LLM assessment and independent human evaluation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: PQB covers three Amazon product domains with 6,516 query instances in total, and is evaluated on five retrieval models representing lexical, learned sparse, dense bi-encoder, late-interaction, and hybrid architectures, together with two LLM-based ranking models.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: PQB covers three Amazon product domains with 6,516 query instances in total, and is evaluated on five retrieval models representing lexical, learned sparse, dense bi-encoder, late-interaction, and hybrid architectures, together with two LLM-based ranking models.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Results show that even when the information need is held fixed, personalized expression differences still induce measurable ranking variation; different retrieval models exhibit clearly different sensitivities to syntactic variation and writing-error variation, while higher overall retrieval effectiveness does not necessarily correspond to stronger robustness against expression variation.
